byteSlice.description: Specifies the sub-string range a facet feature applies to. Start index is inclusive, end index is exclusive. Indices are zero-indexed, counting bytes of the UTF-8 encoded text. NOTE: some languages, like Javascript, use UTF-16 or Unicode codepoints for string slice indexing; in these languages, convert to byte arrays before working with facets. Byte slices can overlap.

main.description: Block-level rich-text facets not covered by at.markpub.facets.baseBlocks - paragraph alignment and named article typography variants. Same index/features shape as at.markpub.facets.baseBlocks, kept as a separate lexicon rather than a fork of it. An audio-embed facet was considered and descoped, not built.

textAlign.description: Facet feature setting paragraph alignment. The byteSlice provided should span the whole paragraph the alignment applies to.

typography.description: Facet feature marking a paragraph as using a named article typography variant beyond plain body text (e.g. an Arabic-script paragraph or blockquote rendered in a different font/size/justification than the surrounding text). The byteSlice provided should span the whole paragraph the variant applies to.
